channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Chad accuses Sudan of air strike near shared border that killed 12
item.description: An air strike on a fuel market near Chad's border with Sudan killed 12 and injured seven, according to officials.

item.title: Iran says it will name its terms for reopening Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran to issue terms for reopening Strait of Hormuz as mediating countries send delegations to Tehran to revive talks.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran prepares conditions to open Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran says it is preparing to draft conditions to open the Strait of Hormuz following mediator requests.

item.title: Two killed in 'domestic violence incident' at school near Berlin
item.description: Police have arrested a 19-year-old male suspect after an incident in which two people were killed near the German capital.

item.title: Board of Peace's Gaza envoy criticises Israeli strikes and Hamas actions
item.description: Nickolay Mladenov warns that a collapse of last October's ceasefire would be "a point of no return" for the region.

item.title: Jellyfish force partial shutdown of French nuclear plant
item.description: It is the second consecutive year that jellyfish has forced the closure of the Gravelines power station in northern France.

item.title: People pulled from mud in Nepal after deadly flash floods
item.description: At least 160 people have been killed along the Nepal-Tibet border as rescuers struggle to reach the disaster zone.
